title: More Than a Map: Timing in the Bulb

scenes.tts: So far the bulb's output was a set of active glomeruli. Is that all the cortex receives?
scenes.visual: Title card: More Than a Map: Timing in the Bulb. A set of lit glomeruli, with a sniff wave drawn beneath.
scenes.narration: So far the bulb's output was a set of active glomeruli. Is that all the cortex receives?

scenes.tts: No. The bulb reshapes the pattern with inhibition, and the pattern carries timing.
scenes.visual: Two labels appear: inhibition, timing.
scenes.narration: No. The bulb reshapes the pattern with inhibition, and the pattern carries timing.

scenes.tts: The key contact is a reciprocal dendrodendritic synapse, one dendrite signalling to another and back.
scenes.visual: Inset: a mitral dendrite beside a granule cell dendrite, with arrows both ways.
scenes.narration: The key contact is a reciprocal dendrodendritic synapse, one dendrite signalling to another and back.

scenes.tts: A mitral or tufted dendrite releases glutamate onto the interneuron. The interneuron releases gabba back onto the same dendrite.
scenes.caption: A mitral or tufted dendrite releases glutamate onto the interneuron. The interneuron releases GABA back onto the same dendrite.
scenes.visual: The arrow out is labelled glutamate; the arrow back is labelled GABA.
scenes.narration: A mitral or tufted dendrite releases glutamate onto the interneuron. The interneuron releases GABA back onto the same dendrite.

scenes.tts: The loop can inhibit the cell that excited it. That is recurrent inhibition.
scenes.visual: The mitral cell that fired dims after the GABA returns. Label: recurrent inhibition.
scenes.narration: The loop can inhibit the cell that excited it. That is recurrent inhibition.

scenes.tts: One interneuron touches many output cells, so it can also inhibit neighbours. That is lateral inhibition.
scenes.visual: One granule cell touches several mitral dendrites; a neighbouring mitral cell dims too. Label: lateral inhibition.
scenes.narration: One interneuron touches many output cells, so it can also inhibit neighbours. That is lateral inhibition.

scenes.tts: Granule cells are not the only source of this inhibition.
scenes.visual: A periglomerular cell in the glomerular layer also lights. Label: not granule cells alone.
scenes.narration: Granule cells are not the only source of this inhibition.

scenes.tts: This resembles the lateral inhibition of sensory coding. But the bulb is not a retina.
scenes.visual: A small retina centre-surround icon beside the bulb circuit, with a not-equal sign.
scenes.narration: This resembles the lateral inhibition of sensory coding. But the bulb is not a retina.

scenes.tts: Each mitral cell is influenced by a few scattered glomeruli, not a ring of neighbours around it.
scenes.visual: One mitral cell with influence lines to a few scattered glomeruli; a faded centre-surround ring beside it is crossed out.
scenes.narration: Each mitral cell is influenced by a few scattered glomeruli, not a ring of neighbours around it.

scenes.tts: Now timing. A sniff is a cycle of breathing in and breathing out.
scenes.visual: A sniff cycle drawn as a wave: inhalation up, exhalation down.
scenes.narration: Now timing. A sniff is a cycle of breathing in and breathing out.

scenes.tts: A spike's phase is where in that cycle it falls.
scenes.visual: A spike tick placed on the wave; a marker shows its position in the cycle. Label: phase.
scenes.narration: A spike's phase is where in that cycle it falls.

scenes.tts: A review of bulb coding concluded that the relative timing of activity in the bulb conveys odour information.
scenes.visual: Label: Uchida and colleagues, 2014, review. Spike ticks from several cells at different phases.
scenes.narration: A review of bulb coding concluded that the relative timing of activity in the bulb conveys odour information.

scenes.tts: Whether and how downstream circuits use that timing has been debated.
scenes.visual: A question mark over the arrow to the cortex.
scenes.narration: Whether and how downstream circuits use that timing has been debated.

scenes.tts: Tufted and mitral cells lock to opposite phases of the sniff. They are parallel channels, not copies.
scenes.visual: Tufted spikes cluster at one part of the wave, mitral spikes at the opposite part. Label: Fukunaga and colleagues, 2012.
scenes.narration: Tufted and mitral cells lock to opposite phases of the sniff. They are parallel channels, not copies.

scenes.tts: Sister cells make a sharp test. Do cells that share one glomerulus send the same message?
scenes.visual: Two sister cells under one gold glomerulus.
scenes.narration: Sister cells make a sharp test. Do cells that share one glomerulus send the same message?

scenes.tts: Dhawahlay and colleagues recorded in anaesthetized adult mice.
scenes.caption: Dhawale and colleagues recorded in anaesthetized adult mice.
scenes.visual: Label: Dhawale and colleagues, 2010. Electrodes near mitral and tufted cells.
scenes.narration: Dhawale and colleagues recorded in anaesthetized adult mice.

scenes.tts: A light-based method found which recorded cells received input from one parent glomerulus.
scenes.visual: Light shines on one glomerulus; two recorded cells respond and are tagged sisters.
scenes.narration: A light-based method found which recorded cells received input from one parent glomerulus.

scenes.tts: So sisters were defined by their input, not by how they responded to odours.
scenes.visual: Label: sisters defined by input.
scenes.narration: So sisters were defined by their input, not by how they responded to odours.

scenes.tts: Pause and predict. Sisters share one input. Will their rates match? Will their timing against the breath match?
scenes.visual: Two empty panels: mean rate bars and spike rasters against the sniff. On screen: match or differ?
scenes.narration: Pause and predict. Sisters share one input. Will their rates match? Will their timing against the breath match?

scenes.visual: the question stays on screen

scenes.tts: Counting mean spikes, sister responses were correlated.
scenes.visual: Rate-response profiles for the two sisters across several odours rise and fall together, though not identically. Caption: correlated tuning, not equal rates.
scenes.narration: Counting mean spikes, sister responses were correlated.

scenes.tts: But against the breathing cycle, an odour shifted the timing of sisters differently.
scenes.visual: The rasters against the sniff wave: for one odour, the two sisters fire at clearly different phases.
scenes.narration: But against the breathing cycle, an odour shifted the timing of sisters differently.

scenes.tts: Rate made them look alike. Timing did not. A shared glomerulus is a shared address, not a shared message.
scenes.visual: On screen: a shared address, not a shared message.
scenes.narration: Rate made them look alike. Timing did not. A shared glomerulus is a shared address, not a shared message.

scenes.tts: Read this within its limits. The mice were anaesthetized, and mitral and tufted cells were pooled.
scenes.visual: Two small caveat tags: anaesthetized; mitral and tufted pooled.
scenes.narration: Read this within its limits. The mice were anaesthetized, and mitral and tufted cells were pooled.

scenes.tts: So some timing differences may reflect cell type or state.
scenes.visual: The tags link to the timing panel with a dashed line.
scenes.narration: So some timing differences may reflect cell type or state.

scenes.tts: So the cortex receives a timed map shaped by inhibition. It turns that into a distributed code that its network reshapes and that drifts.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: a timed map in; a reshaped, drifting code out.
scenes.narration: So the cortex receives a timed map shaped by inhibition. It turns that into a distributed code that its network reshapes and that drifts.
